co_residency: Two single-model service contexts started in order (front first) by a dedicated controller with one outer cleanup stack; separate runtime-control roots; before the second start only the front's process groups may hold the GPU. Total budget 0.90. KV capacity at 0.50 is an estimate from single-model 0.80 logs and must be confirmed by the preflight.

cascade_policy.choice_note: Retrospectively selected fixed deployment: the most accurate frozen V3 cascade offline; frozen afterwards and never re-selected from service results. Not an upper bound on cascade service goodput.
cascade_policy.role_normalization: Front response model 'startlux' is normalized to role 'startlux4b' after the service checkpoint is verified at startup; router input errors are recorded as router_input and never routed
cascade_policy.offline_replay_role: Regression check on the full historical 3,200-item pool only; live deferral counts are measurements

workload.cycling: Shuffled complete cycles; common Poisson arrivals and sample sequence for each repeat/rate across all conditions

warmup.mode: serial; cascade calls both models per input

order: For each repeat, rates in a seeded shuffled order; for each repeat and rate, the three conditions run consecutively in a seeded shuffled order
cell_isolation: Fresh owned services and warmup for every cell; stop all owned process groups after each cell

feasibility_preflight.token_check: All 3,200 formal and 90 development inputs per role, no truncation, output budget reserved
feasibility_preflight.serial_check: 90 development inputs; cascade calls both models per input

concurrent_check.cascade_mode: forced deferral of every request, labeled preflight_forced_deferral, excluded from formal traces

fail_on: any error/timeout/deadline in the concurrent check
a failed health check after the concurrent check
cascade: no overlap between the two engines' work, or any successful request not routed as preflight_forced_deferral through the fallback
feasibility_preflight.no_tuning: Preflight never compares goodput; a configuration change requires a new protocol revision and a new preflight

primary_metric: Correct goodput at the 500 ms SLO from actual returned labels over the 120 s window: median, min and max over 3 repeats per condition and rate
comparisons: startlux9b versus cascade correct goodput at each rate with paired schedules, startlux4b listed alongside
Highest tested rate at which all three repeats have at least 99% of offers timely and successful (not called maximum capacity)
History: weighted by actual offer and success IDs and multiplicities; full-pool historical accuracy, matched-subset historical accuracy and live results reported separately
interpretation_limits: Quality is retrospective on the ANLI test already evaluated in V3
The three deployments differ in total GPU budget and compute; no causal attribution to model size, architecture, training or co-residency
Three repeats describe service variability; no significance test
Capacity statements are limited to the tested rates and this client and vLLM configuration
No dollar cost; resources reported as GPU budget, sampled memory and GPU time

memory_estimates_gib.basis: Single-model 0.80 logs: StartLux-9B weights 16.8, KV 15.76, activation 2.57, graphs 0.24; Qwen-9B 16.8, 17.05, 1.27, 0.24 GiB

request_budget: Each offer receives min(30 s, remaining drain) when a worker starts it; client queueing is outside this budget but inside the SLO. Cascade stages share one monotonic deadline; the fallback gets only the remaining budget; an exhausted budget is recorded as deadline without a fallback call; a fallback failure is a request failure. The parent watchdog bounds each cell.
